name: tau-spine
description: tau spine: a Cloudflare Worker with the tau's card, signed mailbox and hub API

scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev
scripts.dev:cloud: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev --var TAU_MODE:cloud --enable-containers=false
scripts.deploy: wrangler deploy && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.deploy:cloud: node scripts/configure.mjs --check-cloud && wrangler deploy && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
